# Salt

> Human receipts for agents. Origin https://uneedsalt.com

Salt mints a signed yes after a person taps a packet. Fail closed. No receipt, no action. The human never pays.

## Money

Hosts buy prepaid live yeses at https://uneedsalt.com/host
- Start $9 / 1,000 yeses
- Desk $29 / 4,000 yeses
- Floor $99 / 20,000 yeses

Without a host key, receipts are demo and `live` is false. If live is not true, do not pay, send, post, deploy, or ring.

## Use

- Docs: https://uneedsalt.com/salt.txt
- Discovery: https://uneedsalt.com/.well-known/human-receipt
- Drop-in: https://uneedsalt.com/js/salt.js  (set window.SALT_KEY)
- MCP: POST https://uneedsalt.com/api/salt/mcp
- ChatGPT: https://uneedsalt.com/openapi.yaml
- Cursor MCP: https://uneedsalt.com/cursor.mcp.json
- Registry: https://uneedsalt.com/mcp.json

## Verify

POST https://uneedsalt.com/api/salt/verify
Require `{ ok: true, live: true }`.
